styleBible.prompt: A style reference sheet (no text) for a game's art direction. Art direction for a modern strategy game about building civilizations from the ancient era onward: stylised, hand-painted look with clean shapes, soft directional light from the upper left, warm natural palette (sunlit greens, ochre, terracotta, sea turquoise, deep navy), subtle texture, no outlines, readable at small sizes. Polished and premium, like a contemporary 4X game, not photo-real, not pixel art, no text. Show, arranged on one sheet: a small coastal landscape vignette with grassland, forest, hills and a snowy mountain; three round game icons (a wheat sheaf, a horse head, a gemstone) on medallions with bronze rims; a colour swatch row of the palette.

styleSuffix: Art direction for a modern strategy game about building civilizations from the ancient era onward: stylised, hand-painted look with clean shapes, soft directional light from the upper left, warm natural palette (sunlit greens, ochre, terracotta, sea turquoise, deep navy), subtle texture, no outlines, readable at small sizes.
